Mary Barra Transformed GM. Her Successor May Have to Do It Again.

Under Barra, GM has become leaner and more profitable—but the next CEO faces high-tech challenges in China and beyond

By

and

General Motors GM -2.28 % decrease; down pointing triangle Chief Executive Mary Barra entered Nasdaq headquarters on Tuesday to usher in what she hopes will be a new era for the 118-year-old automaker.

She strode past a fire-engine-red Corvette and a row of trucks parked outside the building. Overhead, a video showcasing GM’s vehicle lineup lit up the tower’s seven-story display for all of Times Square to see.
